from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Separator lines are full rows/columns of one color.
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    separators = {grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows} | {grid[0][c] for c in sep_cols}
    values = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
              if r not in sep_rows and c not in sep_cols]
    background = Counter(values).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Partition into the rectangular cells between separator lines.
    row_bands = []
    start = 0
    for r in sep_rows + [h]:
        if start < r:
            row_bands.append((start, r))
        start = r + 1
    col_bands = []
    start = 0
    for c in sep_cols + [w]:
        if start < c:
            col_bands.append((start, c))
        start = c + 1
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in row_bands:
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in col_bands:
            tile = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
            marker_count = sum(v != background and v not in separators for v in tile)
            row.append(1 if marker_count >= 2 else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
